dispute.claim_text: Driver did not take the BKE like everyone does, he went some roundabout way through Mandai and Upper Thomson. Took 32 minutes for a trip that normally takes 27. I paid $29.91. This is not the route I would have taken and I want the extra charge back.

counterparty_statement.text: BKE had a slow crawl near Dairy Farm so I came off and used Upper Thomson. Same distance more or less. I did not charge anything extra.

admissibility.notes: Trip record complete and causally ordered.
Unbroken 10 s telemetry, 100% coverage, no gaps.
Single driver message flagging the BKE crawl; delivered and read, no rider reply.

messages.text: boss BKE quite jam, i go Upper Bukit Timah ok?

admissibility.notes: Line items reconcile to total_charged to the cent.

issue_details.detail: No LTA advisory covers the BKE or the Upper Bukit Timah corridor in the 11:16-11:55 window on 19 July 2026.

admissibility.notes: Artifact absent. The identifier is minted anyway so that the absence itself can be cited by either advocate.
